notes:
Account background: Stratus Harbor runs container scheduling + booking engine for global shipping customers. Heavy-duty inference currently used for customer support chat (latency target 150ms p95), document search/QA across manifests, and reranking for booking suggestions. They started on Redwood Hosted in 2022, moved to a small Dedicated pool in 2024 for predictable throughput. Renewal/expansion context: Renewal due May 2026; they want to expand Dedicated into eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1 and pilot Redwood Optimize across chat + search to cut token spend by ~20-30%.

Recent meetings / signals: 
- "2026-01-22 product deep-dive" — Rafael walked through autoscaling & prefix cache. Customer: "need predictable p95 during regional peak windows or we'll lose SLA credits."
- "2026-02-12 Optimize POC" — Rafael + Maya observed 18% token reduction on first 7 days for reranking workload, negligible latency delta. Stratus: "impressed but want to see production run for 30 days".
- Security: Completed Redwood security questionnaire v2.2; legal wants explicit data residency addendum and HSM/KMS key pull controls. CISO flagged retention policy for logs (90 days max).
- Pricing: Procurement asked for two quotes: (A) renewal + region expansion (EU + APAC) with current GPU SKU (A100) and (B) renewal + expansion + H100 option for peak — +30% list. They want a lens on unit economics (cost per 1M tokens) for each option.

POC / Technical notes: 
- Workload characteristics: chat traffic concentrated 08:00-14:00 EST, search queries steady, reranking spiky around vessel arrival windows.
- Latency SLOs: chat p95 <= 200ms (prefer 150ms), search p95 <= 400ms, reranking throughputs target 2k qps for peak batching windows.
- Model preferences: prefer Llama-2-family quantized variants for reranking/search; open to Redwood-verified LLMs for chat.
- Routing policy: want region-first routing with cost-based fallback to hosted region; require failover to a lower-capacity Dedicated pool rather than Hosted in event of regional outage.

Commercials & renewal ask: 
- Current ARR: ~$340k (Reserved Dedicated + Hosted overage). Renewal target: expand ARR to $420k-$480k with region expansion and Optimize adoption.
- Ask: include 60-day rollout credit for Optimize + training workshop; 3-month no-penalty right-sizing for Dedicated after go-live.

Quotes from the customer: 
- "We need predictions we can put into SLAs — can't accept weekly surprises." — Head of Platform
- "If Optimize saves what you demoed, the ROI is straightforward, but procurement needs numbers." — Procurement lead
